The source of the attack was traced to host 10.0.5.14, which exhibited lateral movement and C2 beaconing behavior. The incident remains unresolved at the SOC level and requires executive and IAM team intervention.

rule GoldenTicket_Forge_Detection {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns associated with mimikatz sekurlsa::tickets /export for Golden Ticket extraction"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        maltype = "CredentialTheft"
    strings:
        $s1 = "* Ticket Encryption Type: 0x17 (RC4_HMAC) *" wide ascii
        $s2 = "* Start Time *" wide ascii
        $s3 = "* End Time *" wide ascii
        $s4 = "* Renew Until *" wide ascii
        $s5 = "kerberos" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of ($s*)
}
